SELECTED_INDEX: 9
CONFIDENCE: 0.82
EXPLANATION: The strong band at 2233 cm⁻¹ indicates a nitrile C≡N stretch, and the prominent 1626 cm⁻¹ band matches an aromatic C=C ring stretch. The peaks at ~3040 cm⁻¹ (aromatic C–H stretch), ~1019 cm⁻¹ (ring breathing), and ~754 cm⁻¹ (aromatic C–H out-of-plane bend) plus CH₃ features at 2896–2997 and 1454 cm⁻¹ strongly suggest an aromatic methyl nitrile. Candidate 9 (tolunitrile) uniquely matches this aromatic nitrile pattern, whereas aliphatic nitrile candidates or those with O–H would show different signatures (e.g., O–H stretches near 3200–3600 cm⁻¹, which are absent).
